# AnimalTracker Plan A: Foundation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Turn the scaffold into the AnimalTracker app shell: local-only SwiftData store, the Animal model, media file storage, the global animal switcher with five placeholder tabs, Manage Animals, and a Settings shell with the API key field.

**Architecture:** SwiftUI app generated by XcodeGen. All records live in a local SwiftData store (`cloudKitDatabase: .none`). Media (photos, videos, audio) are files under `Documents/Media/` behind a `MediaStore` protocol with an in-memory test double. One selected animal (`@AppStorage("selectedAnimalId")`) is resolved once in `RootTabView` and injected into the environment; every tab reads it. Pure logic (species defaults, selection resolution, image processing) lives in files without SwiftData imports so it is unit-tested on the simulator without a container.

**Tech Stack:** Swift 5 language mode, SwiftUI, SwiftData, PhotosUI, UIKit image APIs, Security (keychain), XcodeGen, XCTest.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-animal-tracker-design.md` (sections: Rulings, Constraints, Top-level navigation, Data model/Animal, Settings, Manage Animals, Logic/SpeciesDefaults + MediaStore, Project layout). Later plans: B voice, C buttons, D feed, E poop + health, F oral check-in, G export/import.

## Global Constraints

- iOS deployment target `17.0`; Swift 5 language mode (`SWIFT_VERSION = 5.0`); never Swift 6 strict concurrency.
- Product name `AnimalTracker`, bundle id `com.ashlab.AnimalTracker`, app target `AnimalTracker`, test target `AnimalTrackerTests`, scheme `AnimalTracker`. Test files use `@testable import AnimalTracker`.
- No iCloud, no Sign in with Apple, no entitlements file, no third-party packages. The two local packages `AnimalVoiceAudio` and `AnimalVoiceStats` stay as they are.
- SwiftData store is local: `ModelConfiguration(cloudKitDatabase: .none)`; tests use `isStoredInMemoryOnly: true`.
- Every model has `id: UUID = UUID()` and `createdAt: Date = Date()`. Enums are stored as String raw values.
- Media directory: `<Documents>/Media/`. File names: `<uuid>-photo.jpg` (longest side 2048 px, JPEG quality 0.85), `<uuid>-thumb.jpg` (300 px), `<uuid>-video.mov`, `<uuid>-audio.m4a`.
- Species suggestions, verbatim: horse, pony, donkey, dog, cat, goat, sheep, cow, pig, chicken, rabbit, other. `tracksOutdoorTime` defaults true for horse, pony, donkey, goat, sheep, cow, pig, chicken; false otherwise. `isCat` is `species.lowercased().contains("cat")`.
- Selected animal: `@AppStorage("selectedAnimalId")` (String, UUID text). If it points at an archived or missing animal, the first non-archived animal by sortOrder is selected.
- Keychain: service `AnimalTracker`, account `anthropic-api-key` for the API key.
- Info.plist keys: `UIFileSharingEnabled` true, `LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace` true, `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`, `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription`.
- Build and test: `scripts/test-packages.sh`, `scripts/build-app.sh`, `scripts/test-app.sh`, `scripts/run-sim.sh`. Commit after every task with the message shown; do not push.

```markdown
# AnimalTracker

iPhone app for logging an animal's AAC button presses, feed, poop, and health check-ins, an oral AI check-in, and voice recordings with on-device meaning analysis. Design: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-animal-tracker-design.md`.

## Build

Prerequisite: `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer` and `brew install xcodegen`.

- `scripts/test-packages.sh`  runs the audio and stats package tests on macOS
- `scripts/build-app.sh`      generates the Xcode project and builds for the simulator
- `scripts/test-app.sh`       runs the app tests on the simulator
- `scripts/run-sim.sh`        builds, installs, launches in the simulator, screenshots to build/screenshot.png

To install on a phone with personal signing, set `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` in `project.yml` to your personal team id, run `xcodegen generate`, then build to the device:
`xcodebuild -project AnimalTracker.xcodeproj -scheme AnimalTracker -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -allowProvisioningUpdates build`
```

`scripts/run-sim.sh`:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build, install, launch in the simulator, and screenshot to build/screenshot.png
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
SIM="$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep -m1 -oE 'iPhone [^(]+' | sed 's/ *$//')"
scripts/build-app.sh
xcrun simctl boot "$SIM" 2>/dev/null || true
open -a Simulator
APP="$(find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData -maxdepth 6 -path '*Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/AnimalTracker.app' | head -1)"
xcrun simctl install "$SIM" "$APP"
xcrun simctl launch "$SIM" com.ashlab.AnimalTracker
sleep 4
mkdir -p build
xcrun simctl io "$SIM" screenshot build/screenshot.png
echo "screenshot: build/screenshot.png"
```
```bash
chmod +x scripts/run-sim.sh
```

`App/Views/Shared/ColorPalette.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI

/// Twelve preset colors for animals and buttons, plus hex helpers.
enum ColorPalette {
    static let presets: [String] = [
        "#2A78D6", "#EB6834", "#1BAF7A", "#EDA100", "#E87BA4", "#008300",
        "#4A3AA7", "#E34948", "#00A3B4", "#8B5A2B", "#6B7280", "#111827",
    ]
    static let defaultHex = presets[0]

    static func color(_ hex: String) -> Color {
        var s = hex.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).uppercased()
        if s.hasPrefix("#") { s.removeFirst() }
        guard s.count == 6, let v = UInt32(s, radix: 16) else { return Color.gray }
        return Color(red: Double((v >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255, green: Double((v >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255, blue: Double(v & 0xFF) / 255)
    }

    static func hex(_ color: Color) -> String {
        let ui = UIColor(color)
        var r: CGFloat = 0, g: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0
        ui.getRed(&r, green: &g, blue: &b, alpha: &a)
        return String(format: "#%02X%02X%02X", Int(round(r * 255)), Int(round(g * 255)), Int(round(b * 255)))
    }

    /// Black or white, whichever reads better on the given background.
    static func contrastingText(on hex: String) -> Color {
        var s = hex.uppercased()
        if s.hasPrefix("#") { s.removeFirst() }
        guard s.count == 6, let v = UInt32(s, radix: 16) else { return .white }
        let r = Double((v >> 16) & 0xFF), g = Double((v >> 8) & 0xFF), b = Double(v & 0xFF)
        let luminance = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255
        return luminance > 0.6 ? .black : .white
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import SwiftData

@Model
final class Animal {
    var id: UUID = UUID()
    var createdAt: Date = Date()
    var name: String = ""
    /// Free text; see SpeciesDefaults.suggestions. Never empty after the form validates.
    var species: String = ""
    var colorHex: String = ColorPalette.defaultHex
    /// Relative to Documents/Media/, e.g. "<uuid>-photo.jpg".
    var photoFilename: String?
    var photoThumbnailFilename: String?
    var tracksOutdoorTime: Bool = true
    var sortOrder: Int = 0
    var isArchived: Bool = false
    var note: String?

    init(name: String, species: String, colorHex: String = ColorPalette.defaultHex,
         tracksOutdoorTime: Bool? = nil, sortOrder: Int = 0) {
        self.name = name
        self.species = species
        self.colorHex = colorHex
        self.tracksOutdoorTime = tracksOutdoorTime ?? SpeciesDefaults.tracksOutdoorTime(species)
        self.sortOrder = sortOrder
    }

    var isCat: Bool { species.lowercased().contains("cat") }

    var displayInitial: String { String(name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).prefix(1)).uppercased() }
}
```

`App/Logic/SpeciesDefaults.swift` (needed by the initializer; its tests come in Task 3):
```swift
import Foundation

enum SpeciesDefaults {
    static let suggestions = ["horse", "pony", "donkey", "dog", "cat", "goat", "sheep", "cow", "pig", "chicken", "rabbit", "other"]
    private static let outdoorSpecies: Set<String> = ["horse", "pony", "donkey", "goat", "sheep", "cow", "pig", "chicken"]

    /// True for pasture and yard animals; false for dogs, cats, rabbits, and anything unknown.
    static func tracksOutdoorTime(_ species: String) -> Bool {
        outdoorSpecies.contains(species.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).lowercased())
    }
}
```

`App/Persistence/PersistenceController.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import SwiftData

enum PersistenceController {
    /// Every @Model type in the app. Later plans append their models here.
    static let modelTypes: [any PersistentModel.Type] = [
        Animal.self,
    ]

    static var schema: Schema { Schema(modelTypes) }

    /// Local-only store. No CloudKit, by design (spec ruling 1).
    static func makeContainer(inMemory: Bool = false) throws -> ModelContainer {
        let config = inMemory
            ? ModelConfiguration(isStoredInMemoryOnly: true, cloudKitDatabase: .none)
            : ModelConfiguration(cloudKitDatabase: .none)
        return try ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: [config])
    }
}
```

`App/Logic/Snapshots.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

/// Value copies of models so logic and IO can be tested without a SwiftData container.
struct AnimalSnapshot: Equatable, Identifiable {
    let id: UUID
    let name: String
    let species: String
    let tracksOutdoorTime: Bool
    let isArchived: Bool
    let sortOrder: Int

    init(id: UUID, name: String, species: String, tracksOutdoorTime: Bool, isArchived: Bool, sortOrder: Int) {
        self.id = id
        self.name = name
        self.species = species
        self.tracksOutdoorTime = tracksOutdoorTime
        self.isArchived = isArchived
        self.sortOrder = sortOrder
    }

    init(_ animal: Animal) {
        self.init(id: animal.id, name: animal.name, species: animal.species, tracksOutdoorTime: animal.tracksOutdoorTime,
                  isArchived: animal.isArchived, sortOrder: animal.sortOrder)
    }
}
```

`App/Logic/SelectedAnimalResolver.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

enum SelectedAnimalResolver {
    /// The stored id if it names a non-archived animal, else the first non-archived animal by sortOrder, else nil.
    static func resolve(storedID: String, animals: [AnimalSnapshot]) -> UUID? {
        let active = animals.filter { !$0.isArchived }.sorted { $0.sortOrder < $1.sortOrder }
        if let id = UUID(uuidString: storedID), active.contains(where: { $0.id == id }) {
            return id
        }
        return active.first?.id
    }
}
```

`App/Persistence/AnimalDeletionPolicy.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import SwiftData

/// An animal can be deleted only when it has no records in any domain; otherwise archive it.
enum AnimalDeletionPolicy {
    /// Record counts by domain name. Each domain plan adds one entry here.
    static func recordCounts(for animal: Animal, context: ModelContext) throws -> [String: Int] {
        var counts: [String: Int] = [:]
        _ = animal
        _ = context
        return counts
    }

    static func canDelete(_ animal: Animal, context: ModelContext) throws -> Bool {
        try recordCounts(for: animal, context: context).values.allSatisfy { $0 == 0 }
    }

    /// "3 presses, 2 feed days" for the blocking alert.
    static func summary(_ counts: [String: Int]) -> String {
        counts.filter { $0.value > 0 }.sorted { $0.key < $1.key }.map { "\($0.value) \($0.key)" }.joined(separator: ", ")
    }
}
```

```swift
import XCTest
@testable import AnimalTracker

final class MediaStoreTests: XCTestCase {
    private func tempRoot() -> URL {
        FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("media-\(UUID().uuidString)")
    }

    func testFileStoreSavesPhotoAndThumbnailAndDeletes() throws {
        let store = FileMediaStore(root: tempRoot())
        let saved = try store.savePhoto(TestImages.jpeg(width: 3000, height: 1500))
        XCTAssertTrue(saved.filename.hasSuffix("-photo.jpg"))
        XCTAssertTrue(saved.thumbnailFilename.hasSuffix("-thumb.jpg"))
        XCTAssertEqual(saved.filename.dropLast("-photo.jpg".count), saved.thumbnailFilename.dropLast("-thumb.jpg".count))
        XCTAssertTrue(store.exists(saved.filename))
        XCTAssertTrue(store.exists(saved.thumbnailFilename))
        let photoSize = try XCTUnwrap(ImageProcessing.pixelSize(of: Data(contentsOf: store.url(for: saved.filename))))
        XCTAssertEqual(photoSize.width, 2048, accuracy: 1)
        store.delete(saved.filename)
        store.delete(saved.thumbnailFilename)
        XCTAssertFalse(store.exists(saved.filename))
    }

    func testFileStoreCopiesVideoAndAudio() throws {
        let store = FileMediaStore(root: tempRoot())
        let src = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("\(UUID().uuidString).m4a")
        try Data([0, 1, 2, 3]).write(to: src)
        let audio = try store.saveAudio(from: src)
        XCTAssertTrue(audio.hasSuffix("-audio.m4a"))
        XCTAssertEqual(try Data(contentsOf: store.url(for: audio)), Data([0, 1, 2, 3]))
        let vsrc = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("\(UUID().uuidString).mov")
        try Data([9]).write(to: vsrc)
        XCTAssertTrue(try store.saveVideo(from: vsrc).hasSuffix("-video.mov"))
    }

    func testFileStoreRejectsBadPhoto() {
        let store = FileMediaStore(root: tempRoot())
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try store.savePhoto(Data([1, 2, 3])))
    }

    func testInMemoryStoreBehavesTheSame() throws {
        let store = InMemoryMediaStore()
        let saved = try store.savePhoto(TestImages.jpeg(width: 100, height: 100))
        XCTAssertTrue(store.exists(saved.filename))
        XCTAssertTrue(store.exists(saved.thumbnailFilename))
        XCTAssertNoThrow(try Data(contentsOf: store.url(for: saved.filename)))
        store.delete(saved.filename)
        XCTAssertFalse(store.exists(saved.filename))
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try store.savePhoto(Data()))
    }
```

`App/Logic/ImageProcessing.swift`:
```swift
import UIKit

/// Pure functions over image bytes. Orientation is baked in by UIGraphicsImageRenderer.
enum ImageProcessing {
    static func pixelSize(of data: Data) -> CGSize? {
        guard let image = UIImage(data: data) else { return nil }
        return CGSize(width: image.size.width * image.scale, height: image.size.height * image.scale)
    }

    static func downscaledJPEG(_ data: Data, maxSide: CGFloat = 2048, quality: CGFloat = 0.85) -> Data? {
        resizedJPEG(data, maxSide: maxSide, quality: quality)
    }

    static func thumbnailJPEG(_ data: Data, side: CGFloat = 300) -> Data? {
        resizedJPEG(data, maxSide: side, quality: 0.8)
    }

    private static func resizedJPEG(_ data: Data, maxSide: CGFloat, quality: CGFloat) -> Data? {
        guard let image = UIImage(data: data) else { return nil }
        let pixelWidth = image.size.width * image.scale
        let pixelHeight = image.size.height * image.scale
        let longest = max(pixelWidth, pixelHeight)
        guard longest > 0 else { return nil }
        let scale = min(1, maxSide / longest)
        let target = CGSize(width: (pixelWidth * scale).rounded(), height: (pixelHeight * scale).rounded())
        let format = UIGraphicsImageRendererFormat()
        format.scale = 1
        let rendered = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: target, format: format).image { _ in
            image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: target))
        }
        return rendered.jpegData(compressionQuality: quality)
    }
}
```

`App/Media/MediaStore.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import SwiftUI

struct SavedPhoto: Equatable {
    let filename: String
    let thumbnailFilename: String
}

enum MediaStoreError: Error {
    case invalidImage
    case writeFailed(String)
}

/// Where photos, videos, and audio live. Filenames are relative; the store owns the directory.
protocol MediaStore {
    func savePhoto(_ data: Data) throws -> SavedPhoto
    func saveVideo(from url: URL) throws -> String
    func saveAudio(from url: URL) throws -> String
    func url(for filename: String) -> URL
    func exists(_ filename: String) -> Bool
    func delete(_ filename: String)
}

enum MediaNaming {
    static func photo(_ id: UUID = UUID()) -> (photo: String, thumb: String) {
        ("\(id.uuidString.lowercased())-photo.jpg", "\(id.uuidString.lowercased())-thumb.jpg")
    }
    static func video(_ id: UUID = UUID()) -> String { "\(id.uuidString.lowercased())-video.mov" }
    static func audio(_ id: UUID = UUID()) -> String { "\(id.uuidString.lowercased())-audio.m4a" }
}

/// Test double: bytes held in memory, `url(for:)` materializes a temp file on demand.
final class InMemoryMediaStore: MediaStore {
    private var files: [String: Data] = [:]
    private let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("inmem-\(UUID().uuidString)")

    init() {}

    func savePhoto(_ data: Data) throws -> SavedPhoto {
        guard let photo = ImageProcessing.downscaledJPEG(data), let thumb = ImageProcessing.thumbnailJPEG(data) else {
            throw MediaStoreError.invalidImage
        }
        let names = MediaNaming.photo()
        files[names.photo] = photo
        files[names.thumb] = thumb
        return SavedPhoto(filename: names.photo, thumbnailFilename: names.thumb)
    }

    func saveVideo(from url: URL) throws -> String {
        let name = MediaNaming.video()
        files[name] = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        return name
    }

    func saveAudio(from url: URL) throws -> String {
        let name = MediaNaming.audio()
        files[name] = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        return name
    }

    func url(for filename: String) -> URL {
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let url = tempDir.appendingPathComponent(filename)
        if let data = files[filename] { try? data.write(to: url) }
        return url
    }

    func exists(_ filename: String) -> Bool { files[filename] != nil }

    func delete(_ filename: String) {
        files[filename] = nil
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir.appendingPathComponent(filename))
    }
}

private struct MediaStoreKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue: MediaStore = FileMediaStore()
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    var mediaStore: MediaStore {
        get { self[MediaStoreKey.self] }
        set { self[MediaStoreKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}
```

`App/Media/FileMediaStore.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

/// Files under Documents/Media/, visible in the Files app because Info.plist enables file sharing.
final class FileMediaStore: MediaStore {
    static let documentsMedia: URL = {
        let docs = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        return docs.appendingPathComponent("Media", isDirectory: true)
    }()

    let root: URL

    init(root: URL = FileMediaStore.documentsMedia) {
        self.root = root
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    }

    func savePhoto(_ data: Data) throws -> SavedPhoto {
        guard let photo = ImageProcessing.downscaledJPEG(data), let thumb = ImageProcessing.thumbnailJPEG(data) else {
            throw MediaStoreError.invalidImage
        }
        let names = MediaNaming.photo()
        try write(photo, to: names.photo)
        try write(thumb, to: names.thumb)
        return SavedPhoto(filename: names.photo, thumbnailFilename: names.thumb)
    }

    func saveVideo(from url: URL) throws -> String {
        let name = MediaNaming.video()
        try copy(url, to: name)
        return name
    }

    func saveAudio(from url: URL) throws -> String {
        let name = MediaNaming.audio()
        try copy(url, to: name)
        return name
    }

    func url(for filename: String) -> URL { root.appendingPathComponent(filename) }

    func exists(_ filename: String) -> Bool { FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url(for: filename).path) }

    func delete(_ filename: String) { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url(for: filename)) }

    private func write(_ data: Data, to filename: String) throws {
        do { try data.write(to: url(for: filename), options: .atomic) } catch { throw MediaStoreError.writeFailed(error.localizedDescription) }
    }

    private func copy(_ src: URL, to filename: String) throws {
        do { try FileManager.default.copyItem(at: src, to: url(for: filename)) } catch { throw MediaStoreError.writeFailed(error.localizedDescription) }
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

struct RootTabView: View {
    @Query(sort: \Animal.sortOrder) private var animals: [Animal]
    @AppStorage(AppStorageKeys.selectedAnimalId) private var selectedAnimalId = ""
    @State private var showFirstRun = false

    private var selected: Animal? {
        let id = SelectedAnimalResolver.resolve(storedID: selectedAnimalId, animals: animals.map(AnimalSnapshot.init))
        return animals.first { $0.id == id }
    }

    var body: some View {
        TabView {
            tab("Buttons", "square.grid.2x2") { Text("Buttons") }
            tab("Feed", "leaf") { Text("Feed") }
            tab("Poop", "circle.dotted") { Text("Poop") }
            tab("Health", "heart.text.square") { Text("Health") }
            tab("Voice", "waveform") { Text("Voice") }
        }
        .environment(\.selectedAnimal, selected)
        .onAppear { syncSelection() }
        .onChange(of: animals.count) { _, _ in syncSelection() }
        .fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showFirstRun) {
            NavigationStack { ManageAnimalsView(isFirstRun: true) }
        }
    }

    private func tab<Content: View>(_ title: String, _ symbol: String, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) -> some View {
        NavigationStack {
            content()
                .navigationTitle(title)
                .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
                .animalToolbar()
        }
        .tabItem { Label(title, systemImage: symbol) }
    }

    /// Keeps the stored id valid and opens first-run setup when there is nothing to select.
    private func syncSelection() {
        let resolved = SelectedAnimalResolver.resolve(storedID: selectedAnimalId, animals: animals.map(AnimalSnapshot.init))
        if let resolved, resolved.uuidString != selectedAnimalId { selectedAnimalId = resolved.uuidString }
        showFirstRun = resolved == nil
    }
}
```

`App/Media/CameraCaptureView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import UIKit

/// UIImagePickerController in camera mode. Photo returns JPEG data; video returns the temporary movie URL.
struct CameraCaptureView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {
    enum Mode { case photo, video }

    var mode: Mode
    var maxVideoSeconds: TimeInterval = 60
    var onPhoto: (Data) -> Void = { _ in }
    var onVideo: (URL) -> Void = { _ in }
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    static var isCameraAvailable: Bool { UIImagePickerController.isSourceTypeAvailable(.camera) }

    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> UIImagePickerController {
        let picker = UIImagePickerController()
        picker.sourceType = Self.isCameraAvailable ? .camera : .photoLibrary
        picker.mediaTypes = mode == .photo ? ["public.image"] : ["public.movie"]
        if mode == .video {
            picker.videoMaximumDuration = maxVideoSeconds
            picker.videoQuality = .typeHigh
        }
        picker.delegate = context.coordinator
        return picker
    }

    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: UIImagePickerController, context: Context) {}

    func makeCoordinator() -> Coordinator { Coordinator(self) }

    final class Coordinator: NSObject, UIImagePickerControllerDelegate, UINavigationControllerDelegate {
        let parent: CameraCaptureView
        init(_ parent: CameraCaptureView) { self.parent = parent }

        func imagePickerController(_ picker: UIImagePickerController, didFinishPickingMediaWithInfo info: [UIImagePickerController.InfoKey: Any]) {
            if let image = info[.originalImage] as? UIImage, let data = image.jpegData(compressionQuality: 0.95) {
                parent.onPhoto(data)
            } else if let url = info[.mediaURL] as? URL {
                parent.onVideo(url)
            }
            parent.dismiss()
        }

        func imagePickerControllerDidCancel(_ picker: UIImagePickerController) {
            parent.dismiss()
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import PhotosUI

struct AnimalFormView: View {

                        Button("Take photo") { showCamera = true }
                        if pendingPhoto != nil || (animal?.photoFilename != nil && !removePhoto) {
                            Button("Remove photo", role: .destructive) { pendingPhoto = nil; removePhoto = true }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Section("Details") {
                Toggle("Tracks outdoor time", isOn: $tracksOutdoorTime)
                    .onChange(of: tracksOutdoorTime) { _, _ in outdoorTouched = true }
                TextField("Note", text: $note, axis: .vertical)
            }
            if let errorMessage {
                Section { Text(errorMessage).foregroundStyle(.red) }
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle(animal == nil ? "Add Animal" : "Edit Animal")
        .toolbar {
            ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) { Button("Save", action: save).disabled(!canSave) }
            ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Cancel") { dismiss() } }
        }
        .onAppear(perform: load)
        .onChange(of: pickerItem) { _, item in
            Task {
                if let data = try? await item?.loadTransferable(type: Data.self) { pendingPhoto = data; removePhoto = false }
            }
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showCamera) {
            CameraCaptureView(mode: .photo, onPhoto: { data in pendingPhoto = data; removePhoto = false })
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var photoPreview: some View {
        if let pendingPhoto, let image = UIImage(data: pendingPhoto) {
            Image(uiImage: image).resizable().scaledToFill().frame(width: 72, height: 72).clipShape(Circle())
        } else if let animal, !removePhoto, let thumb = animal.photoThumbnailFilename,
                  let image = UIImage(contentsOfFile: mediaStore.url(for: thumb).path) {
            Image(uiImage: image).resizable().scaledToFill().frame(width: 72, height: 72).clipShape(Circle())
        } else {
            Circle().fill(ColorPalette.color(colorHex)).frame(width: 72, height: 72)
                .overlay(Text(String(name.prefix(1)).uppercased()).font(.title).foregroundStyle(ColorPalette.contrastingText(on: colorHex)))
        }
    }

    private func load() {
        guard let animal else { return }
        name = animal.name
        species = animal.species
        colorHex = animal.colorHex
        customColor = ColorPalette.color(animal.colorHex)
        tracksOutdoorTime = animal.tracksOutdoorTime
        outdoorTouched = true
        note = animal.note ?? ""
    }

    private func save() {
        let target = animal ?? Animal(name: name, species: species, sortOrder: (allAnimals.map(\.sortOrder).max() ?? -1) + 1)
        target.name = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        target.species = species.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        target.colorHex = colorHex
        target.tracksOutdoorTime = tracksOutdoorTime
        target.note = note.isEmpty ? nil : note
        do {
            if removePhoto || pendingPhoto != nil {
                if let old = target.photoFilename { mediaStore.delete(old) }
                if let oldThumb = target.photoThumbnailFilename { mediaStore.delete(oldThumb) }
                target.photoFilename = nil
                target.photoThumbnailFilename = nil
            }
            if let pendingPhoto {
                let saved = try mediaStore.savePhoto(pendingPhoto)
                target.photoFilename = saved.filename
                target.photoThumbnailFilename = saved.thumbnailFilename
            }
            if animal == nil { context.insert(target) }
            try context.save()
            if selectedAnimalId.isEmpty { selectedAnimalId = target.id.uuidString }
            dismiss()
        } catch {
            errorMessage = "Could not save: \(error.localizedDescription)"
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

struct ManageAnimalsView: View {
    var isFirstRun = false
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(\.mediaStore) private var mediaStore
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Query(sort: \Animal.sortOrder) private var animals: [Animal]
    @State private var showAdd = false
    @State private var editing: Animal?
    @State private var blockedMessage: String?

    private var active: [Animal] { animals.filter { !$0.isArchived } }
    private var archived: [Animal] { animals.filter(\.isArchived) }

    var body: some View {
        List {
            Section {
                ForEach(active) { animal in
                    row(animal)
                        .swipeActions(edge: .trailing) {
                            Button("Archive") { animal.isArchived = true; try? context.save() }.tint(.orange)
                            Button("Delete", role: .destructive) { delete(animal) }
                        }
                }
                .onMove(perform: move)
            } header: {
                Text(active.isEmpty ? "Add your first animal" : "Animals")
            }
            if !archived.isEmpty {
                Section("Archived") {
                    ForEach(archived) { animal in
                        row(animal)
                            .swipeActions(edge: .trailing) {
                                Button("Unarchive") { animal.isArchived = false; try? context.save() }.tint(.green)
                                Button("Delete", role: .destructive) { delete(animal) }
                            }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .overlay {
            if animals.isEmpty {
                ContentUnavailableView("No animals yet", systemImage: "pawprint",
                                       description: Text("Add an animal to start logging."))
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle("Manage Animals")
        .toolbar {
            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
                Button { showAdd = true } label: { Image(systemName: "plus") }.accessibilityLabel("Add animal")
            }
            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarLeading) {
                if !isFirstRun || !active.isEmpty { Button("Done") { dismiss() } }
            }
            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) { EditButton() }
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showAdd) { NavigationStack { AnimalFormView(animal: nil) } }
        .sheet(item: $editing) { animal in NavigationStack { AnimalFormView(animal: animal) } }
        .alert("Cannot delete", isPresented: Binding(get: { blockedMessage != nil }, set: { if !$0 { blockedMessage = nil } })) {
            Button("OK") {}
        } message: { Text(blockedMessage ?? "") }
        .onAppear { if isFirstRun && animals.isEmpty { showAdd = true } }
        .onChange(of: active.count) { _, n in if isFirstRun && n > 0 { dismiss() } }
    }

    private func row(_ animal: Animal) -> some View {
        Button { editing = animal } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                AnimalAvatarView(animal: animal, size: 40)
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(animal.name).font(.headline).foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    Text(animal.species).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func move(from source: IndexSet, to destination: Int) {
        var ordered = active
        ordered.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)
        for (i, a) in ordered.enumerated() { a.sortOrder = i }
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func delete(_ animal: Animal) {
        do {
            let counts = try AnimalDeletionPolicy.recordCounts(for: animal, context: context)
            guard counts.values.allSatisfy({ $0 == 0 }) else {
                blockedMessage = "\(animal.name) has \(AnimalDeletionPolicy.summary(counts)). Archive it instead."
                return
            }
            if let photo = animal.photoFilename { mediaStore.delete(photo) }
            if let thumb = animal.photoThumbnailFilename { mediaStore.delete(thumb) }
            context.delete(animal)
            try context.save()
        } catch {
            blockedMessage = error.localizedDescription
        }
    }
}
```

`App/CheckIn/KeychainStore.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import Security

/// Generic-password keychain items. The Anthropic API key lives here and nowhere else.
struct KeychainStore {
    static let apiKeyAccount = "anthropic-api-key"

    let service: String

    init(service: String = "AnimalTracker") {
        self.service = service
    }

    enum KeychainError: Error { case status(OSStatus) }

    private func query(_ account: String) -> [String: Any] {
        [kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
         kSecAttrService as String: service,
         kSecAttrAccount as String: account]
    }

    func get(_ account: String) -> String? {
        var q = query(account)
        q[kSecReturnData as String] = true
        q[kSecMatchLimit as String] = kSecMatchLimitOne
        var result: AnyObject?
        guard SecItemCopyMatching(q as CFDictionary, &result) == errSecSuccess, let data = result as? Data else { return nil }
        return String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)
    }

    func set(_ value: String, account: String) throws {
        let data = Data(value.utf8)
        var status = SecItemUpdate(query(account) as CFDictionary, [kSecValueData as String: data] as CFDictionary)
        if status == errSecItemNotFound {
            var add = query(account)
            add[kSecValueData as String] = data
            status = SecItemAdd(add as CFDictionary, nil)
        }
        guard status == errSecSuccess else { throw KeychainError.status(status) }
    }

    func delete(_ account: String) {
        SecItemDelete(query(account) as CFDictionary)
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct SettingsView: View {
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @AppStorage("checkInQuestionCap") private var questionCap = 8
    @AppStorage("speakQuestions") private var speakQuestions = true
    @State private var apiKeyDraft = ""
    @State private var hasStoredKey = KeychainStore().get(KeychainStore.apiKeyAccount) != nil
    @State private var keyMessage: String?

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section("Animals") {
                NavigationLink("Manage Animals") { ManageAnimalsView() }
            }
            Section("Oral check-in") {
                SecureField(hasStoredKey ? "API key saved (enter to replace)" : "Anthropic API key", text: $apiKeyDraft)
                    .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
                    .autocorrectionDisabled()
                HStack {
                    Button("Save key") { saveKey() }.disabled(apiKeyDraft.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty)
                    Spacer()
                    if hasStoredKey { Button("Remove key", role: .destructive) { removeKey() } }
                }
                if let keyMessage { Text(keyMessage).font(.footnote).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                Stepper("Max follow-up questions: \(questionCap)", value: $questionCap, in: 1...20)
                Toggle("Speak questions aloud", isOn: $speakQuestions)
            }
            Section("Tags") {
                SettingsPlaceholderRow(title: "Poop tags")
                SettingsPlaceholderRow(title: "Voice tags")
            }
            Section("Data") {
                SettingsPlaceholderRow(title: "Export")
                SettingsPlaceholderRow(title: "Import")
            }
            Section("About") {
                LabeledContent("Version", value: Bundle.main.infoDictionary?["CFBundleShortVersionString"] as? String ?? "dev")
                Text("All records and media stay on this phone. Only oral check-in transcripts are sent to Anthropic, using your own key.")
                    .font(.footnote).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle("Settings")
        .toolbar { ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) { Button("Done") { dismiss() } } }
    }

    private func saveKey() {
        do {
            try KeychainStore().set(apiKeyDraft.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces), account: KeychainStore.apiKeyAccount)
            apiKeyDraft = ""
            hasStoredKey = true
            keyMessage = "Key saved to the keychain."
        } catch {
            keyMessage = "Could not save key: \(error)"
        }
    }

    private func removeKey() {
        KeychainStore().delete(KeychainStore.apiKeyAccount)
        hasStoredKey = false
        keyMessage = "Key removed."
    }
}
```
